text:
riley: heads-up from CSM: MedCore has a dispute on INV-2026-99876 — they say platform fee pricing for Private Deployments should've been adjusted during a 60-day capacity pilot. asking for retro credit + revised invoice before renewal.
tasha: can you drop the invoice lines? I'll pull the contract.
riley: pasted from PDF: 
```
INV-2026-99876
Period: 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31
1x Private Deployment Platform Fee (annual) - $60,000
Support: Premium Tier (annual) - $16,000
Pilot note: 60-day pilot (50% capacity) on Dedicated during 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-30 (ops ticket OPS-5011)
Overage: committed GPU true-up - 300 hrs @ $15/hr = $4,500
```
riley: MedCore says sales agreed verbally to reduce platform fee pro-rata for the pilot period and that we've double-billed because pilot was supposed to be charged as a "deployment-neutral" test. They attached an email that says "apply pilot concession" but no signed amendment.
deepak: contract review: SOW 2.1 says platform fee is annual and non-refundable unless amendment signed. verbal concords don't change T&Cs. we need signed amendment or Exec-level waiver.
bella: ops confirms OPS-5011 shows 50% capacity routed to Dedicated for 60 days starting 2026-06-01. no billing change requested in the ops ticket.
tasha: customer asks for two items: (A) one-time retro credit for platform fee for 50% * 60/365 = 60,000 * 0.5 * 60/365 = $4,931.51, (B) true-up on GPU hours is disputed because they claim some hours were test runs covered by pilot. they provided usage logs.
legal: send me the proof of sales authorization and CSM email. if sales promised concession we can consider a limited waiver, but need SAR and exec approval.
riley: here's the CSM email and the sales slack screenshot. not signed though. CSM says AE verbally confirmed in a call.
bella: ops also annotated the pilot as "no charge change" in the ticket. conflict of records.
deepak: proposed finance approach: 1) apply immediate support proration if requested (customer had Premium only from 2026-05-15, otherwise Standard). 2) create provisional credit memo for the platform pilot amount but mark as "pending legal". 3) hold collections action while we investigate.
tasha: support proration calc: Premium (16k) - Standard (6k) = 10k diff. Premium effective 2026-05-15, so credit for Standard period (4/1-5/14 = 44 days) = 10,000 * 44/365 = $1,205.48 -> small, can grant immediately.
riley: customer wants immediate reversal of the overbilling to avoid stopping payment on the renewal. they prefer a billing note and credit entry showing good faith.
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-900 created for $1,205.48 (support proration). Reference INV-2026-99876. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
deepak: I'll review CM-2026-900. For the platform pilot credit ($4,931.51), legal must approve. I'll draft a concession memo and SAR justification: "customer retention risk; pilot miscommunication".
legal: if sales confirmation exists in written comms we can process a one-time commercial credit up to $5k w/ sign-off required from Head of Revenue. escalate if >$5k.
riley: platform credit calc rounded = $4,931.51 (under $5k). looks like we can proceed with Head of Revenue signoff. I'll loop @cecil.
tasha: what about the GPU true-up? customer provided logs showing 120 hrs were test runs. we need ops to verify and if confirmed, reduce overage from 300 to 180 = 180 * $15 = $2,700 (credit $1,800).
bella: ops verified logs: 115 hrs flagged as dev/test and should be excluded under pilot. i'll attach OPS-5011 notes to invoice record.
\illing-bot: (typo bot) ignore
billing-bot: automated: provisional credit memo CM-2026-901 created for GPU-hour adjustment amount $1,725. Reference INV-2026-99876. Status: pending revenue-ops approval.
deepak: combined provisional credits = $1,205.48 + $1,725 + (platform $4,931.51 pending legal) = $7,862 approx.
legal: I'm ok to approve platform credit provided sales confirmation in written comms or Head of Revenue approves. add SAR reason and record as one-time commercial concession.
riley: customer requested invoice payment hold until 2026-08-15. can collections do that for strategic renewals?
tasha: yes we can grant a 45-day hold for strategic accounts; collections will be notified. I'll set hold through 2026-08-15.
deepak: action items: (1) revenue-ops: approve CM-2026-900 and CM-2026-901 -> assigned to @deepak; (2) legal+sales: confirm written sales concession or get Head of Revenue approval for platform credit -> assigned to @legal + @tasha; (3) ops: attach OPS-5011 notes to invoice record -> assigned to @bella; (4) collections: apply payment hold through 2026-08-15 -> assigned to @tasha.
riley: I'll update MedCore and ask for patience while we finalize platform credit. they asked for written confirmation by EOD 2026-07-20.
bella: attached OPS-5011 to the invoice in billing system.
billing-bot: automated: invoice INV-2026-99876 placed on hold until 2026-08-15. Collections notified.
tasha: thanks all. closing loop once credits post and legal confirms platform concession. :handshake:
